pages.title: Major Malla Rama Gopal Naidu — first from Telugu states to get Kirti Chakra

facts.text: Who: Major Malla Rama Gopal Naidu, born 16 June 1995, Nagaripenta, Santhabommali mandal, Srikakulam
facts.head: News

facts.text: Feat: killed five terrorists on the LoC in Kupwara, J&K — zero Indian casualties
facts.head: News

facts.text: ⚠ First from AP and Telangana to receive the Kirti Chakra
facts.head: News

facts.text: Career: Lieutenant 2016, Captain 2018, Major 2022
facts.head: News

facts.text: ⚠ Second-highest peacetime gallantry award (after Ashoka Chakra)
facts.head: Background — Kirti Chakra

facts.text: Instituted: 1952; civilians and military; posthumous allowed; presented by the President
facts.head: Background — Kirti Chakra

pages.title: Prof KL Krishna receives Padma Shri

facts.text: Who: Prof Kosaraju Leela Krishna, economist, native of Unguturu, Krishna district
facts.head: News

facts.text: Conferred by: President Droupadi Murmu at Civil Investiture Ceremony-II, Rashtrapati Bhavan; field education and literature
facts.head: News

facts.text: Born: 16 August 1935; B.Sc Maths Andhra University, M.Sc Statistics Kerala University; trained under C.R. Rao at ISI; PhD University of Chicago (Fulbright)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Roles: President, Indian Econometric Society; founding editor, Journal of Quantitative Economics; led India KLEMS productivity project at DSE (2013–2022, RBI-backed)
facts.head: News
